parameters.name: DagId
parameters.description: The ID of the task flow. You can call the [ListTaskFlow](~~424565~~) or [ListLhTaskFlowAndScenario](~~426672~~) operation to obtain the ID of the task flow.

parameters.name: DagInstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the execution record of the task flow. You can call the [ListTaskFlowInstance](~~424689~~) operation to obtain the execution record ID.

parameters.name: Tid
parameters.description: The ID of the tenant. You can call the [GetUserActiveTenant](~~198073~~) or [ListUserTenants](~~198074~~) operation to obtain the tenant ID.
